g.text: +GET(page, page_size, keyword, min_price, max_price, expertise, campus, min_rating, min_experience_years, availability_status, sort) : 200 | 401* | 403* | 422*
Follow «Path» arrows from CU Ways API and prepend /api/v1, except for the two server-root paths.
The operation arguments show query parameters and JSON request bodies. Path parameters are on the arrows.
«use» connects the resource to its JSON bodies. * identifies the shared ErrorResponse schema.
Representation fields are shown at the body or envelope level. OpenAPI defines nested schemas and constraints.
